legalTerminos.title: Terms and Conditions
intro: Please read these Conditions ("Conditions", "Terms and Conditions") carefully before using the PrecioJusto website (the "Service"), operated by PrecioJusto ("we", "us" or "our").
Your access to and use of the Service is conditioned on your acceptance of and compliance with these Terms. These Conditions apply to all visitors, users and others who access or use the Service.

sections.heading: Account creation and use of the platform
paragraphs: PrecioJusto is a technology platform that allows Customers to find independent Professionals for their service requests.
Users can access the Platform free of charge without registering. To access and/or use certain features of the Platform, you must create an account with an email address and a password.

Only persons over 18 years of age may create an account with us. By creating an account on the Platform, you declare and warrant that you meet the necessary requirements. The Professional further declares and warrants that they are qualified, authorized and insured in accordance with the regulations applicable to the services they offer.

You are responsible for safeguarding the password you use to access the Platform and for any activity or action under your password. PrecioJusto is not liable for losses caused by unauthorized use of your Account.

When creating an account with us, you must provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information at all times. Failure to do so constitutes a breach of the Conditions, which may result in immediate cancellation of your account.

sections.heading: Nature of the service
paragraphs: PrecioJusto is not a service provider. It is a technology platform that allows Customers and Professionals to connect to meet a service need.

Customers understand and accept that PrecioJusto does not guarantee that they will receive a Quote from a Professional for their service request. Likewise, Professionals understand and accept that PrecioJusto does not guarantee that the Quote they send will become a Booking.

Taking the necessary precautions to provide a safe working environment is the responsibility of the Customer and the Professional. PrecioJusto is not responsible for related accidents and losses arising from the absence of such precautions.

paragraphs: Users acknowledge that they are solely responsible for all content —such as ideas, suggestions, service descriptions, photographs, reviews or offers— that they share on the Platform.

PrecioJusto has no obligation, but reserves the right for any reason, to monitor, review or warrant the accuracy, quality, suitability or integrity of any User Content contained or presented on the Platform.

sections.heading: Quotes, payments and invoicing
paragraphs: The Customer pays the Professional directly once the service has been performed, in relation to the total fee of the Quote they have accepted. The Customer must request the invoice or receipt for the paid service from the Professional; the Customer cannot request these documents from PrecioJusto, since PrecioJusto does not perform and is not responsible for any of the Services requested.

Unless otherwise agreed between the Customer and the Professional, the Customer has the right to cancel the project without justification and without penalty, provided the service has not yet started.

Quotes and Request information provided on the Platform are for informational and communication purposes; we recommend formalizing the agreement in writing with the Professional and keeping the document or receipt for any advance payment.

Customers and Professionals acknowledge and accept that PrecioJusto has no liability whatsoever for disputes that may arise between them regarding payment, cancellation of the service, discounts or refunds.

paragraphs: In order to prevent inappropriate messages and maintain a quality, safe service, PrecioJusto may store and analyze communication between Professionals and Customers through the Platform. PrecioJusto reserves the right to use inappropriate content as evidence in court if required by law.

legalPrivacidad.title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy describes how PrecioJusto ("we", "us" or "our"), as data controller, collects, uses and protects the personal data of Platform users.

By using the Service you accept the practices described in this document. For the remaining conditions governing the use of the Platform, please see our [Terms and Conditions](/{lang}/terminos-y-condiciones).

sections.heading: Information we collect
list: Account data: name, email address, password and, where applicable, phone number and city.
Professional profile data: trade or category, experience, rates, working areas, photographs and service descriptions.
Request and booking data: Service Requests, Quotes sent and accepted, messages exchanged between Customer and Professional, and reviews.
Technical data: IP address, device and browser type, and Platform usage data.

sections.heading: How we use your information
list: To provide, operate and maintain the Platform, including publishing professional profiles and managing Requests and Quotes.
To enable communication between Customers and Professionals through the Platform.
To show relevant results and professionals based on your location and service needs.
To manage your account, technical support and service-related communications.
To prevent abuse, spam and fraudulent activities, and keep the Platform secure.
To comply with applicable legal obligations.

sections.heading: Sharing of information
paragraphs: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We only share your information in the following cases:

With the Professional or Customer involved in a Service Request, to the extent necessary to manage the relationship (e.g., name and contact details). As a general rule, your email address and phone number are not publicly displayed on the Platform.
With providers who support us in operating the Service (hosting, analytics, support), who process the data as processors under our instructions.
Where there is a legal obligation or a request from a competent authority, or if we believe in good faith that it is necessary to protect our rights, your safety or the safety of others.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use strictly necessary cookies for the operation of the Platform (keeping you signed in, remembering your preferences and ensuring security) and analytics cookies to understand how the Platform is used and improve it. You can configure your browser to refuse them, although this may affect the functionality of the Service.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss or alteration, including encryption of communications via SSL/TLS. No system is completely secure, but we work to keep the protection of your data up to date with industry standards.

sections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We retain your personal data while your account is active or as needed to provide you with the Service. If you cancel your account, we will delete or anonymize your data unless we must keep it to comply with legal obligations or resolve disputes.

sections.heading: Your rights (GDPR)
paragraphs: In accordance with the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation, you have the right to:
list: Access the personal data we process about you.
Rectify inaccurate or incomplete data.
Request the erasure of your data when it is no longer necessary.
Restrict or object to the processing of your data.
Request portability of your data in a structured format.
Withdraw your consent at any time.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
paragraphs: The Service is not directed to individuals under 18 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you are a parent or guardian and believe a minor has provided us with personal data, please contact us so we can delete it.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post any changes on this page and update the "last updated" date. If the changes are material, we will notify you with reasonable advance notice before they take effect.

sections.heading: Contact us
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or about the processing of your data, you can exercise your rights by writing to legal@preciojusto.com.
